Review of `miniweb/` — issues found:

- `miniweb/auth.py`: Token compared with `==` (timing side-channel); logs raw token at INFO; header lookup is case-sensitive; `replace("Bearer ", "")` accepts malformed prefixes.
- `miniweb/request.py`: Mutable default argument `params={}` is shared across instances.
- `miniweb/cache.py`: Cache key is only `request.path`, ignoring method/query/headers (e.g. POST/GET or different auth collide).
- `miniweb/response.py`: `Content-Length` computed as `len(self.body)` (character count), which is wrong for multi-byte bodies or byte strings.
- `miniweb/router.py`: `match` uses substring check (`route in path`), so `/foo` matches `/bar/foo/baz`.
- `miniweb/validators.py`: `clamp(n, low, high)` returns `max(high, min(n, low))` — the bounds are inverted; verified it always returns `high`.

`__init__.py` and `utils.py` look fine.
